errors.text_span: gefolgt von einem Rückgang bis 2021 auf etwa 6,5
errors.evidence: The value for the West line in 2021 is approximately 6.65, not 6.5. The description understates the value by more than a grid line increment.

errors.text_span: einem Tiefpunkt von etwa 6,5 im Jahr 2021
errors.evidence: The value for the Gesamtdeutschland line in 2021 is clearly on the 6.6 grid line, not 6.5.

The value for the West line in 2024 is visibly higher than the Gesamtdeutschland line (which is at approx. 7.1) and is closer to 7.2. Stating it is 7.1 is inaccurate and misses the fact that it is the highest value of the three lines in 2024.

errors.text_span: Die Linie für Ost (hellblau, Kreis-Markierungen, durchgezogene Linie)
errors.evidence: The description uses 'hellblau' (light blue) for both the West line and the Ost line, which is ambiguous as the two lines have distinct shades of blue. The Ost line is a much lighter, almost greyish blue.
The starting value for the Ost line in 2011 is approximately 6.7, not 6.6.

errors.text_span: mit einem Maximum von etwa 6,8 im Jahr 2019
errors.evidence: The maximum value for the Ost line is approximately 6.9 and it occurs in 2016, not 6.8 in 2019.

errors.text_span: einem Tiefpunkt von etwa 6,4 im Jahr 2021
errors.evidence: The value for the Ost line in 2021 is exactly on the 6.5 grid line, not 6.4.
The value for the Ost line in 2024 is visibly below the 6.9 level, closer to 6.85.
